subject: SCI101
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering 5 core topics in introductory physics. The English selections are dominated by highly-rated channels like The Organic Chemistry Tutor and Professor Dave Explains, chosen for their clarity and massive reach. The Arabic selections feature popular university-level lectures that provide in-depth explanations and problem-solving strategies. All chosen videos are highly relevant, meet all quality gates, and are well-suited for university students.

videos.title: Free Fall Physics Problems - Acceleration Due To Gravity
